'''Elbra''' was a world located in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Rage (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Rage'']] intercepted a exchange of supplies between the [[Airam Clans]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] near Elbra.<ref name="BoP" />
